component.name: Piopio
component.summary: Chat over XMPP with end-to-end encryption

description.p: Piopio is an XMPP client that talks to Conversations, Dino and Converse.js users without anyone noticing a difference. OMEMO encryption is on from the first message.
A small background service does all the network work, so messages and notifications keep arriving with no window open and almost no memory used.
The name comes from the North Island piopio, a New Zealand thrush whose quick, whistling call gave it its Māori name.
Project skeleton: the background service starts on the session bus, and the window opens.
